Name: PopcornMania
Author: Damadelfalco
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/63ZRkqPb/testata.png[/img]﻿
[b]Popcorn lovers, this one's for you![/b]

Popcorn is the ultimate snack for those chill moments—whether you're hanging out with friends, enjoying a solo movie night, or just cozying up for a session of Stardew!

I’ve put together a wide variety of flavors (including some pretty wild ones! :D) that come packed with different buffs to help you on your farm.
[color=#ffff00][u]
[size=3][b]UPDATE:[/b][/size][/u][/color][b][color=#ffff00][size=3][u]
I have removed the planting restrictions outside of the farm or greenhouse to prevent any compatibility issues with modded farms or greenhouses. These seeds can now be planted during Spring, Summer, and Fall.[/u][/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#00ff00]How it works:
[/color][/b]You’ll receive a letter in the mail—think of it as a little "mini-quest"—inviting you to the lab inside the Carpenter’s Shop.
There, good old Demetrius will tell you about some Iridescent Corn seeds he found on your farm and decided to "tweak" and improve.
At the end of the scene, Demetrius will give you 5 Iridescent Corn seeds to get you started!
The day after you get your seeds, you’ll receive two additional letters from Demetrius. One includes the blueprints for the Popcorn Machine,
and the other is a sweet thank-you note for helping him discover those incredible seeds! Use your Iridescent Corn to whip up special batches of popcorn with unique, powerful buffs!

[b][u][color=#00ff00]A few things to keep in mind:[/color][/u][/b]

[list]
[*][b]Exclusive Seeds:[/b] [color=#00ff00][u]These seeds aren't sold in any shop![/u][/color] To get more, you'll need to use the [b]Seed Maker[/b], so make sure you save a few ears of corn instead of eating them all!
[*][b]Requirements:[/b] The event triggers starting from [b]Year 2[/b] once you reach[b] Farming Level 6[/b] (which you'll also need to process the corn in the Seed Maker).
[*][b]Seeding Freedom:[/b] Initially, these seeds were meant only for the Farm, but due to their magical nature (and to ensure they work with all your favorite Greenhouse and Farm mods!), they can now be planted anywhere you find tillable soil!
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hjmxkvYM/tit_popcorn.png[/img]

[b][color=#00ffff]New Flavors & Recipes![/color][/b]

I’ve created [b]15 different popcorn flavors[/b], ranging from the classic buttered snack to some totally wild and mouth-watering combinations!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7Y3YmMj1/popcorn.gif[/img]

To make them, you’ll first need to whip up various sauces and toppings.
You can find all the necessary recipes for sale at Gus’s Stardrop Saloon—they’ll become available once you’ve received both your Iridescent Corn seeds and the Popcorn Machine from Demetrius.

To get the full experience (and actually make those tasty sauces!), make sure you’ve got [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url] installed. Their ingredients are key to my popcorn recipes!


[b][color=#ff0000]IMPORTANT![/color][/b]

[b]If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url] mod, please make sure you have upgraded your frying pan to the highest level (Gold).
Otherwise, you won’t be able to cook the popcorn recipes that require multiple ingredients!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W4CgYg5D/loveofcooking.jpg[/img]
[/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8C9MXMZb/scheda.png[/img]﻿


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/j5fNp21M/tit_popcornmachine.png[/img]﻿

Like I said, you can build the machine as soon as Demetrius sends you the letter with the crafting recipe!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9fKZgZLZ/popcornmachine.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DzHLpLx5/scheda_popmachine.png[/img]

[b][color=#00ffff]Crafting the Machine[/color][/b]

To build your Popcorn Machine, you’re going to need:

    10 Wood
    3 Iron Bars
    1 Oak Resin
    1 Solar Essence

[b][color=#00ffff]How to get started:[/color][/b]

To make the Basic Popcorn Bowl (which you’ll need as a base for all 15 flavors), you'll need 3 Corn and 1 bottle of Oil (the vanilla game one).
Just toss the corn into the machine, and in no time, your fresh bowl of popcorn will be ready!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Zq2pspw6/machine.jpg[/img]

[b][color=#00ffff]The Star of the Show: Iridescent Corn

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J0XdTjZk/seedbag.gif[/img][/color][/b]

Now, let’s talk about the real star of this mod, Iridescent Corn.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3wVmfmtv/mais.jpg[/img]

You can grow this special crop during [b]Spring, Summer, and Fall[/b]. It takes 13 days to fully mature, and after the first harvest, you can continue to pick it every 3 days.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/zf6K2KxC/maisfield.jpg[/img]

[b][u][color=#00ff00]Important Reminders:[/color][/u][/b]

[list]
[*] [b][u]No Shops:[/u][/b] These seeds are not for sale anywhere! You'll need to use a Seed Maker to get more, so plan ahead.
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Qt752Czm/tit_install.png[/img]

Download and install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]
Add the [b]PopcornMania[/b] to your [b]Mods[/b] folder along with all dependencies
It's done!

To remove this mod, simply delete it from the mods folder.
Any items still present in the save file will be considered as incorrect
objects (symbol with red circle and diagonal bar above) and can be
thrown away.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/xCmHw8Zx/tit_translation.png[/img]

Want to translate the mod? DM me or leave a comment if you're interested.
The Italian language is already translated.
If you want to translate to your language find the default.json file in the i18n folder and rename it.
